column1: Visual C# -> Windows Classic Desktop .NET Framework -> Windows Form App
Open your project in Visual Studio.
In Solution Explorer, right-click on the project name (e.g., WindowsFormsApp1).
Select "Manage NuGet Packages..." from the context menu.
Search for the package name (e.g., EasyPost.NetStandard).
Select the desired package to view details, install, or update.
